name: Enterprise Approval Engine – Dynamic Policies & Multi-Level Authorization

parameters.content:
## Enterprise Approval Engine

Receives an approval request, evaluates dynamic policies to determine required authorization levels, runs multi-level approval checks, and returns a final decision with full audit trail.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Approval Request – Receives the approval request payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Load Policies – Validates the request and loads the dynamic policy rules.
3. Code - Evaluate Policies – Applies dynamic policies to determine required approval levels and risk score.
4. Wait - Pre Level 1 – Short pause before Level-1 authorization check.
5. HTTP Request - Level 1 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-1 approver (manager / auto-rule).
6. Code - Process Level 1 – Records Level-1 decision and decides if higher levels are needed.
7. Wait - Pre Level 2 – Pause before Level-2 authorization check.
8. HTTP Request - Level 2 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-2 approver (director / finance).
9. Code - Process Level 2 – Records Level-2 decision and decides if final level is required.
10. Wait - Pre Level 3 – Pause before Level-3 (executive) authorization check.
11. HTTP Request - Level 3 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-3 approver (VP / executive).
12. Code - Process Level 3 – Records Level-3 decision.
13. Code - Build Final Decision – Aggregates all level results into a final approve/reject decision.
14. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the complete approval report with audit trail.
15. Respond to Webhook – Returns the final decision and audit trail to the caller.

## 1. Intake & Policy Evaluation

Webhook - Approval Request – Receives the approval request payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Load Policies – Validates the request and loads the dynamic policy rules.
Code - Evaluate Policies – Applies dynamic policies to determine required approval levels and risk score.

## 2. Multi-Level Authorization

Wait - Pre Level 1 – Short pause before Level-1 authorization check.
HTTP Request - Level 1 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-1 approver (manager / auto-rule).
Code - Process Level 1 – Records Level-1 decision and decides if higher levels are needed.
Wait - Pre Level 2 – Pause before Level-2 authorization check.
HTTP Request - Level 2 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-2 approver (director / finance).
Code - Process Level 2 – Records Level-2 decision and decides if final level is required.
Wait - Pre Level 3 – Pause before Level-3 (executive) authorization check.
HTTP Request - Level 3 Approver – Notifies or checks Level-3 approver (VP / executive).
Code - Process Level 3 – Records Level-3 decision.

## 3. Decision & Respond

Code - Build Final Decision – Aggregates all level results into a final approve/reject decision.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the complete approval report with audit trail.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the final decision and audit trail to the caller.
